## Fixed
- The tab bar on the phone is glass only in the Liquid Glass theme. In the standard theme it is a plain bar with a plain marker, with the same dragging
- The side panel in the Liquid Glass theme is readable: thick frosted glass instead of a see-through pane
- Android: if an update can't be installed over the installed app, the app says so and tells you what to do, instead of failing silently

## Changed
- Liquid Glass bends the light at the rim of the tab bar, the player, menus and notes, with a light colour fringe on the marker (Android app, Windows app, Chrome and Edge)
- Real logos for Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud and Deezer, in search too
- Every tick box is a switch now
- Client ID and keys are hidden until you tap the eye
- Sorting in the library is a row of chips instead of a drop-down
- Admins can set the address for on the go in Settings → On the go

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** uninstall Musik once, then install the new `Musik.apk`
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
